text:
elaine: Quick follow-up from today's townhall re: leveling / promos / comp — I'll collect answers here. First Q: timeline for promo decisions?

maria: Hi! Managers will receive promo decision emails by EOD next Friday (4/2). EM/lead tracks may take an extra week. Docs + links below. :point_down:

devin: Thanks — if a promotion is backdated, does retro pay hit the next payroll automatically?

maria: Retro pay is applied to the effective date shown in the promotion notice. If payroll needs manual adjustments we'll loop in @payroll. Managers, please flag exceptions asap.

kevin: Is there a formal appeal/clarification path if someone disagrees with leveling outcome?

maria: Yes — short appeal form + manager + people-ops review. It's intended for missing evidence or process issues, not a re-eval of calibration outcomes. Link: https://intranet.redwood/review-appeals

amy: Quick one — will IC level changes affect stock refresh eligibility this cycle?

maria: Yes, level changes before the snapshot date (4/15) will be reflected. If you think you missed the cutoff, email compops@redwood.com with the manager confirmation.

hr-bot: Checklist created: /playbooks/promo-checklist — created by people-ops-bot. (use this for manager submissions)

sophie: For distributed teams: are remote folks calibrated equally? heard some concerns.

maria: We require evidence-based examples and the rubric is applied consistently. Calibration panels include reps across regions to reduce bias. If you have a specific scenario DM me and we'll escalate.

tim: Deadline reminder for managers: when do calibration notes need to be in?

maria: Please submit calibration notes by COB 4/8. Use the template below and attach manager feedback.

maria: ```
Template:
- Situation: short summary (1-2 lines)
- Impact: measurable outcomes / customer / product impact
- Evidence: PRs, metrics, peer feedback, timeline
- Proposed change: current level -> proposed level, rationale
```

devin: Rumor check — are comp bands changing for FY27?

maria: High level: bands are being reviewed for next quarter. No structural changes to bands will affect this promo cycle. We'll do a deep dive session next week and share slides.

elaine: Can we centralize an FAQ so managers and ICs can reference?

maria: Already on it — FAQ + living Q&A doc here: https://intranet.redwood/promo-faq (will update as answers come in).

amy: One last quickie — benefits open enrollment dates?

maria: Open enrollment 5/1 - 5/14. Info session planned 5/3 (calendar invite will be sent).

tim: :thumbsup: thanks all

sophie: Appreciate the fast answers. I'll share this thread with my team.

maria: I'll keep updating this thread as new Qs come in. If anyone wants a private convo, DM me.
